notes.title: Update!
notes.notes:
[url=https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33858564/00ec27edea10ded65079b52e3e9efb4953cf716a.png][img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33858564/e4a4cc5ddf9e2fa15e6a53cac884cc8158d3f0f5.png[/img][/url]
[h1] Card update! [/h1]
[list]
[*] New card design!
A new foundation for card design is laid in such a way as to introduce the possibility of customizing game decks in the future!

[*] New card characteristics - level!
The map level will be displayed in the left corner.
In essence, the card level is the coefficient of the total power of the card, based on the number of its characteristics at the beginning of the game.
Due to this, according to the level of the card, it is possible without calculations to see if the card will be victorious. [i][b] (HOWEVER, TAKE INTO ACCOUNT THE GENERAL SITUATION ON THE PLAYER'S FIELD AND THE NUMBER OF YOUR MOVE!) [/b][/i]
The level of each card is calculated individually, according to the general formula.

[*] Correction of some errors
[/list]
